name: Vessel Deviation Monitor
description: Runs every 6 hours. Fetches all approved nominations from the CAP service, iterates over each one, calls the AIS Vessel Tracking Agent to check for significant vessel deviation from the expected path, and — when a deviation is detected — triggers a fresh ETA re-analysis in the CAP service and writes a deviation_flagged audit log entry. This implements the continuous vessel monitoring requirement (REQ-05, M7).

parameters.agents: [{"ordId":"customer.build:apiResource:nomination-eta-agent-9bb0c.nomination-eta-agent:v1","name":"Nomination ETA Agent"},{"ordId":"customer.build:apiResource:nomination-eta-agent-9bb0c.historical-nomination-agent:v1","name":"Historical Nomination Agent"},{"ordId":"customer.build:apiResource:nomination-eta-agent-9bb0c.ais-vessel-tracking-agent:v1","name":"AIS Vessel Tracking Agent"},{"ordId":"customer.build:apiResource:nomination-eta-agent-9bb0c.geo-weather-agent:v1","name":"Geo Weather Agent"}]
parameters.chatInput: =Check for significant vessel deviation. vessel_mmsi={{ $json.vesselMMSI }}, nomination_id={{ $json.nominationId }}, approved_eta={{ $json.approvedETA }}, destination={{ $json.destination }}. If the vessel has deviated significantly (speed drop >20%, unexpected heading change, or ETA has shifted by more than 12 hours), return JSON with deviation_detected=true and deviation_detail. Otherwise return deviation_detected=false.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ reason: 'vessel_deviation', deviation_detail: $json.deviation_detail || 'Significant deviation detected by AIS monitoring' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ nominationId: $('Loop Over Nominations').item.json.nominationId, eventType: 'deviation_flagged', etaValue: $('Loop Over Nominations').item.json.approvedETA, decisionMaker: 'system', agentReasoning: $('Check AIS Agent for Deviation').item.json.deviation_detail || 'Vessel deviation detected — ETA re-analysis triggered', sourceAgents: 'ais-vessel-tracking-agent' }) }}
